name: Idol of Greust
description: Place into an empty Augment Socket in a Shield, a Buckler or a Sceptre to apply its effect to that item. Once socketed it cannot be retrieved but can be replaced by other Augment items.

lines: +25% of Armour also applies to Elemental Damage
Gain Deflection Rating equal to 20% of Evasion Rating
Companions deal 10% more Damage for each different type of dead Companion you have
